The fence is in two places: the upgrade's query (schema_version, editor_schema) and the Hocuspocus token '<schema>:<editor>', whose answer overrides the query's. A bare token is read-only.

A Ctrl/Cmd-click on a linked picture in the editable editor must not be default-prevented by the node view, or ProseMirror never hands it to markdownLinkClickPlugin (picture-view.ts followNoClickWhileEditable); the e2e caught this.

Document dispatch:// clicks are handled in the capture phase (followDispatchLink, both ProofDocument and VersionView), so the past-version view navigates in-app and the link plugin does not also open a new tab.
deviations: Pasted HTML title: the image parseDOM uses the img's title attribute when present (the editor's own DOM always carries it) and falls back to alt only when absent, so an editor copy/paste round-trips byte for byte; a foreign README paste gains title "x" as Milkdown's rule gives today.
Reference-style linked images are not in pmdoc's testdata/corpus: pmdoc refuses link reference definitions today (refusals_test.go); the editor test covers them.
The stay-as-today shape ![[![x](i.png)](u)](j.png) is its own diffcorpus document (linked-image-in-alt.md): engine and Go read the outer alt differently at base already, unrelated to links.
A held browser edit that strips a link is reported through a new PendingState.strippedAt notice, not rebuiltAt.
The past-version view now navigates in-app for any dispatch:// link (text, picture, fallback) on a plain click instead of opening a new tab.
